 Live Last update 7:41 PM ET 10' 7:41 PM ET 3 minutes ago The pace of the match has slowed down a bit
 The pace of the match has slowed down a bit, and Curaçao is moving the ball all over the pitch, aiming to unlock Panama’s defensive setup; there haven’t been many dangerous attacking plays during this stretch, though the game is gradually picking up momentum.

 Key moments

 The intensity of the match is rising, and Curaçao has already had its first dangerous attacking play with a shot from outside the box that was well saved by the Panamanian goalkeeper; the hosts keep up the pressure, looking for a mistake from Panama.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 3' 7:33 PM ET 11 minutes ago Panama is pushing forward
 Panama is pushing forward, looking to play long balls toward an unmarked forward; both teams are playing with great intensity and giving away no space, while Curaçao is currently trying to win back possession.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:31 PM ET 13 minutes ago Kickoff
 The first half between Curaçao and Panama is underway; the match has begun, and there is an immediate, intense battle for possession—two teams featuring talented players, both looking to get off to a strong start in this match.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:25 PM ET 19 minutes ago The national anthems are sung
 The national anthems of Curaçao and Panama are being played ahead of the start of the CONCACAF Nations League quarter-finals; this highly anticipated first-leg match is about to get underway and promises to be very exciting.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:20 PM ET 24 minutes ago All ready
 Everything is set for the start of the match; the players are ready and awaiting the signal to take the field for the pre-match protocol ahead of this quarter-final clash, while the fans are eagerly anticipating the opening whistle.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:15 PM ET 29 minutes ago End of warmup
 The players finish their warm-up and head back to their dressing rooms to receive final instructions from their coaches, before returning to the pitch for the national anthem protocol—we are nearing kickoff.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:10 PM ET 34 minutes ago Great Entrance
 There is a great turnout at Stadion Ergilio Hato; nearly half the stadium is already filled, and a full house is expected by the time the match kicks off. We are just minutes away from the ball rolling in these quarter-finals.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:05 PM ET 39 minutes ago Panama lineup
 Here is Panama’s lineup to face Curaçao in this match, where they will look to secure a win and all 3 points while playing away from home. We are drawing ever closer to the opening 45 minutes of this big match:
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 7:00 PM ET 44 minutes ago Curacao lineup
 This is the Curaçao lineup to face Panama in a highly anticipated match; they are fielding their best players, aiming to secure an advantage on home soil in this first leg of the quarter-finals, great lineup:
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 6:55 PM ET an hour ago All ready warmup
 The players from Curaçao and Panama are beginning to take the field, starting their pre-match preparations for what promises to be a very exciting encounter; there is a fantastic atmosphere building here at the Stadion Ergilio Hato.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 6:50 PM ET an hour ago Fans
 Fans are gradually arriving at the stadium in Curaçao for this match between Curaçao and Panama; the Nations League quarter-finals are underway, and we shall see which team can secure an advantage heading into the return leg.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 6:49 PM ET an hour ago Stadion Ergilio Hato
 This is the home ground for Curaçao and one of the most significant stadiums in the CONCACAF region. With a capacity of 15,000 spectators and inaugurated in 2013, it will host this major match between Curaçao and Panama. A full-capacity crowd is expected, as this is one of the marquee matchups of the quarter-finals - undoubtedly a great stadium for a high-stakes encounter from which only one team will advance in the tournament.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 6:49 PM ET an hour ago Keys of the match
 For this first-leg quarterfinal match, the Panama national team is expected to go all out in search of an advantage. It remains to be seen whether Curaçao can leverage its home-field advantage; we can look forward to an intense encounter featuring plenty of dangerous scoring opportunities this Thursday night.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 6:43 PM ET an hour ago Background
 History favors Panama; in their three previous encounters, Panama has secured two wins, with one match ending in a draw and Curacao recording zero victories. Consequently, the visitors enter tomorrow’s first leg of the quarter-finals as slight favorites to take the advantage. That is the historical context heading into this major football match.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 6:06 PM ET 2 hours ago How is Panama heading into this?
 Panama, meanwhile, is coming off a 1-1 draw against Ecuador in a friendly - a match that proved very useful during the last FIFA international window - which they followed up with a 7-6 victory on penalties. They now face Curaçao, aiming to go all out for a win and secure an advantage in these CONCACAF Nations League quarter-finals. This is how both teams head into this major football match, which promises to be full of intensity, goals, and excitement.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 5:31 PM ET 2 hours ago Referee
 The referee in charge of officiating the match will be Tori Penso. Drawing on her extensive national and international experience, she will be tasked with successfully guiding the game - a contest likely to feature plenty of physical clashes, as both national teams will be giving their all to secure the lead and the victory. She is, without a doubt, an excellent choice to officiate this football match.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López
 4:55 PM ET 3 hours ago Absences
 Neither team has any injured or suspended players, meaning both will be able to field their top stars for this major clash. We shall see which side manages to secure the victory and take an advantage into the return leg of these quarter-finals; here are the players who will be missing for this big encounter.
 Live updates by Juan Carlos Vera López

 Curaçao is coming off a 1-1 draw against Trinidad and Tobago - an exciting match that ultimately ended without a winner. Now, they are set to face Panama in the CONCACAF Nations League quarterfinals, aiming to secure an advantage in this first leg. This is how the Curaçao national team heads into what promises to be an enticing football encounter.
